react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN Web warning: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?' seen on /games/wheel. Likely emitted by the SVG rotation style on the wheel animation. Does NOT break the wheel — animation + server-authoritative segment_index both work. Suggest switching inline style key to camelCase transformOrigin or applying via a transform matrix. Reference: /app/mobile/app/games/wheel.tsx wheel SVG rotation.
Carried-over non-blocking warnings from prior iterations (shadow* RN-Web deprecation, social.tsx require-cycle, Image.resizeMode via style). Not blockers for M4.

action_items: Low-priority: fix RN-Web `transform-origin` -> `transformOrigin` warning on /app/mobile/app/games/wheel.tsx (cosmetic console warning only; wheel animation and server-authoritative result both work).
critical_code_review_comments: ScratchGame.jsx scratch-reveal-all button appears only after a card is dealt and before all tiles are scratched — current conditional (!card || done) renders new-card button, else reveal-all. UX is correct but the branch is dense; consider splitting into a tiny subcomponent for readability (not a bug).

Quiz.js submitAnswer passes {answer_idx: chosen} for dynamic (single-question) and {answers: newAnswers} for multi; GamePlayer handler must accept both shapes. Verified from current code path — but add a backend contract test to prevent future regression.
Mobile wheel.tsx uses style `transform: [{ rotate: ... }]` on SVG — if migrating to Reanimated for smoother spin, verify server-authoritative snap still terminates exactly at segment_index.
All four games correctly derive outcomes from backend response and never roll locally; verified via network inspection + API curl parity. No cosmetic-vs-server drift found.
